risk_note: RV2 payout (withdraw lane B2-05d; model Claude Fable 5.1). POST /v1/withdrawals: the application use case runs on the idempotency claim's transaction (withStepUp + executeInTransaction; code 0 / 3xxxx stored with the key, 1xxxx / 2xxxx not); first pass = the whole BR-WDR-03 chain without locks, then the fixed lock order (identity users row → ledger.lockBalances → pg_advisory_xact_lock on app_id:payee_hmac), the locked re-check of ⑦⑧⑩⑪⑫ over fresh reads, fee / tax fixed from the calculator (net = amount − fee − tax through @couli/money), INSERT in a savepoint with out_biz_no (W + 20 [A-Z0-9]) regenerated at most three times on a unique-key collision, review_mode / review_deadline (auto_payout off → manual + 24 working hours over the console calendar), the WITHDRAW:FREEZE voucher (wd:{id}:FREEZE) through ledger.post under the same balance lock, and wallet.withdrawal_changed / withdrawal.created on the same transaction. identity's payee snapshot port decrypts the bound account only to mask it. Spec-test: Codex 3 attempts + 1 exception attempt (D10-198: one assertion pinning the handler to the idempotency transaction's backend) + 1 exception fix (D10-209: bigint replacer in #7), each extra reviewed by a fresh independent Claude; counts unchanged. The handler takes only @Req() (deletion controller convention) so identity's step-up fixtures swap it (test-change B2-05i). CT-20b (D10-207): the eight withdrawal time-point / sub-text fields are output (B2-05d create response; B2-05f list / detail projection with the response Clock), no money path touched.
